use default

let ten = 10n
let eleven = 11n

rank(values: Collections.List[bigint]) -> bigint is
    let result mut = 1n

    for value in values do
        result = result * eleven + ten

        for digit in value.to_string() do
            result = result * eleven + cast(digit - '0')
        od
    od

    return result
si

unrank(index: bigint) -> LIST[bigint] is
    let digits = LIST()
    let remaining mut = index

    while remaining > 1n do
        let digit = cast int(remaining % eleven)

        digits.add(if digit == 10 then " " else "{digit}" fi)
        remaining = remaining / eleven
    od

    digits.reverse()

    let values = LIST()

    for text in (digits |> join("")).split([' ']) do
        if text.length > 0 then
            values.add(bigint.parse(text))
        fi
    od

    return values
si

let sample = [1, 2, 3, 10, 100, 987654321, 1]
    |> map(v => cast bigint(v))
    |> collect_list()

let index = rank(sample)
let restored = unrank(index)

write_line("list:     {sample |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" ")}")
write_line("rank:     {index}")
write_line("unranked: {restored |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" ")}")
